_nota: Catálogo inglés del cuaderno de insignias (ver data/i18n/en/ui.json).
Las etapas de descenso de los módulos lu: The descent stages of the Lunar Modules (like Apollo 11's Eagle) were left behind as launch pads.
Tres \"autos lunares\" eléctricos conduc: Three electric "moon buggies" driven by astronauts. Parked permanently on the Moon.
Paquetes de experimentos de superficie d: Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Packages (seismometers, retroreflectors, etc.) left to do science after astronauts departed.
Sondas robóticas enviadas en los años 60: Robotic probes sent in the 1960s to prove soft landings were possible.
El primer rover en Marte (1997), llevado: The first rover on Mars (1997), delivered by the Pathfinder lander. Now permanently parked.
Rovers gemelos que funcionaron durante a: Twin rovers that operated for years. Both are now inactive monuments to Mars exploration.
Los primeros módulos de EE. UU. que func: The first U.S. landers to successfully operate on Mars (1976), remaining exactly where they touched down.
Phoenix excavó en busca de hielo de agua: Phoenix dug for water ice; InSight listened for marsquakes. Both eventually lost power.
El primer aparato que voló en otro plane: The first aircraft on another planet. Sustained rotor damage and became a stationary artifact.
Las primeras sondas de espacio profundo: Early deep-space probes that explored the outer planets. Now drifting silently out of the solar system.
Cartografió Vesta y Ceres. Se quedó sin: Mapped Vesta and Ceres. Ran out of fuel and remains in a perpetual, unpowered orbit around Ceres.
La primera nave en orbitar un asteroide: First spacecraft to orbit and land on an asteroid. Left resting on the surface of 433 Eros.
Revolucionario telescopio cazador de exo: Revolutionary exoplanet-hunting telescope that ran out of fuel and is drifting in an Earth-trailing orbit.
